competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a strong mental force, removes a beneficial effect, and destroys the MAX HP by the damage dealt.
Manifests a horrible delusion and attacks all enemies and decreases the Defense for 3 turns. Damage increases according to the number of merges and the amount of enemy's HP destroyed.
Summons 2 of the 3 incarnations within and removes all harmful effects. Each incarnation will have its own skill and characteristics, and will merge with Lyrith after 5 turns.
